The posterior probability of an interval estimation is a measure of its confidence.

the posterior distribution of a parameter is the most informative distribution of the parameter and that the most informative distribution is the best distribution for the purpose of estimation, provided that a decision-theoretic approach is adopted.

the posterior probability of the parameter being in the interval Ij is the optimal confidence coefficient of the Bayesian confidence interval Ij, and the optimal Bayesian confidence interval I* is the one for which this coefficient is 1/2.
